author: kingpanther13
releaseNotes:
v4.6.0 - 2026-10-10
- feat: adopt firmware 2.5.2 hub changes (#520)
  - Hub alerts: see each active alert and dismiss one; pending firmware updates detected again on 2.5.2.
  - Full local backups (database plus files) can be created and restored, network-share backups configured and tested, and cloud backups copied to File Manager.
  - Z-Wave JS: switch stacks, view node details and link reliability, reinterview nodes, run link tests, back up and restore the Z-Wave network, and run batch device firmware updates.
  - Matter devices pair with Wi-Fi credentials on 2.5.2; a pairing can be cancelled.
  - File Manager subfolders, bounded device event windows, a variable type filter and atomic increments.
  - The hub's own Groovy API documentation is searchable through the tool guide.
